subject: Private offer + listing credit pathway for Edgewave AWS SKU
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Kevin Tan <kevin.tan@edgewave.com>
Cc: 
Date: Tue, 16 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Private offer + listing credit pathway for Edgewave AWS SKU

Hi Kevin —

Thanks again for the productive call this morning. To recap: Edgewave wants to list our inference SKU in the AWS Marketplace and use a private offer so you can apply an initial promotional credit to early adopter customers. You asked for a streamlined path that keeps the listing window short and avoids a long contract negotiation for every customer.

What I can do now from Redwood’s side:
- Open a private offer flow in AWS and propose a one-time marketplace credit for first 3 months (applies at purchase).
- Reduce the standard listing admin fee for the first quarter to help with go-to-market economics.
- Provide a draft private-offer wording for Edgewave procurement to review.

Could you share your preferred credit level (percent or flat $) and the procurement contact who should receive our draft? Attaching the SOW you mentioned so our internal finance folks can align on consumption pacing.

Next steps: if you confirm the credit band today we can prepare a private-offer draft and loop in our listing team for a 5–7 business day publish SLA once legal signs off.

Cheers,
Irene
Irene Choi | Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

Attachment: Edgewave_SOW_v1.pdf

From: Kevin Tan <kevin.tan@edgewave.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Edgewave Procurement <procurement@edgewave.com>, Elena Park <elena.park@edgewave.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Feb 2027 11:04:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Private offer + listing credit pathway for Edgewave AWS SKU

Thanks Irene —

Appreciate the clear options. Procurement is leaning toward a blended approach: a 20% marketplace credit for the first 3 months, then a $0.02/token volume credit for the next 9 months (to encourage consumption). Procurement prefers to see the private-offer wording and any marketplace fee reductions in writing before we commit the listing schedule.

I've looped in Elena (procurement lead) — Elena, can you confirm if a 20% / $0.02 structure is within your range or if you need a different split?

Also, please include any constraints (e.g., SKU token thresholds, refunds, or start-date gating) in the draft.

Best,
Kevin
VP, Partnerships | Edgewave Inc
kevin.tan@edgewave.com

Attachment: none

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Wed, 17 Feb 2027 08:22:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: Private offer + listing credit pathway for Edgewave AWS SKU

Irene —

Saw Kevin's ask (20% up-front + $0.02/token follow-on). Given Edgewave's GTM impact and that this is a strategic partner, I'm supportive of an exception but we need Deal Desk sign-off on three items:
1) Net revenue floor (minimum monthly revenue for 6 months) to avoid adverse churn economics.
2) Clarify whether the token credit stacks with our existing channel incentives (we usually do not stack).
3) Exact accounting: whether the up-front 20% is a marketplace credit (applied by AWS) or a Redwood contra-revenue credit (affects how we recognize revenue).

I've attached a current pricing sheet with recommended guardrails. If we escalate to Deal Desk, include the HubSpot deal link and the draft private-offer doc so they can approve faster.

-Ben
Head of GTM Pricing | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

Attachment: RDW_marketplace_pricing_sheet.xlsx

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 17 Feb 2027 09:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Fwd: Private offer + listing credit pathway for Edgewave AWS SKU — Deal Desk request

Marissa / Laura —

Forwarding Kevin's ask and Ben's notes. Requesting Deal Desk approval to proceed with:
- One-time 20% marketplace promotional credit for first 3 months (AWS-applied if possible).
- Follow-on $0.02/token consumption incentive for months 4–12 to drive usage.
- Waive the first-quarter listing admin fee (one-time exception).

Rationales: Edgewave will co-sell in AWS Marketplace, has pipeline across three strategic retailers, and requested speed to market (5–7 business days). The reduction and credits materially help conversion but reduce short-term recognition — Ben's spreadsheet contains proposed floors and the accounting note.

HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/RDW-DEAL-2026-089
Draft private offer is attached for redlines.

Please advise: if approved, I will prepare the private-offer package and request AWS listing team to schedule the publish window. If partial approval, indicate preferred guardrails (rev floor %, stacking rules, or timebox).

Thanks,
Irene

Attachment: Edgewave_PrivateOffer_Draft.docx

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Thu, 18 Feb 2027 15:04:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Private offer + listing credit pathway for Edgewave AWS SKU — Deal Desk request

On Wed, 17 Feb 2027 at 09:05, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com> wrote:
> Marissa / Laura —
> 
> Forwarding Kevin's ask and Ben's notes. Requesting Deal Desk approval to proceed with:
> - One-time 20% marketplace promotional credit for first 3 months (AWS-applied if possible).
> - Follow-on $0.02/token consumption incentive for months 4–12 to drive usage.
> - Waive the first-quarter listing admin fee (one-time exception).

Irene / team —

Approved on the following conditional basis:
1) Net revenue floor = $25k/month for first 6 months (Edgewave must commit to minimum aggregate ARR or we claw back credits).
2) No stacking with existing channel incentives; credits cannot be combined with partner referral rebates.
3) Accounting: the 20% must be AWS-side marketplace credit where possible; if AWS cannot apply it, Redwood will issue a contra-revenue credit but we must capture it in the attached accounting form.
4) Private-offer must include a 60-day review clause; if usage < 50% of forecast, credits will be prorated.

Please send the private offer to procurement with these conditions and copy Deal Desk (dealdesk@redwood.com). If procurement signs, we will route the DocuSign link to Edgewave and request AWS listing intake.

Marissa Cole
Head of Deal Desk / Partner Sales Operations
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Attachment: none
